comment: Known serious or critical axe findings, as (rule, screen) pairs (theme-independent). A serious or critical finding that is NOT listed fails the a11y tests; listed ones are only reported. Remove an entry when its fix merges; this file may end up empty. Edit by hand, never to hide a new regression.

entries.reason: Wave 3 drill-down control in the Data tab: button aria-label 'Add drill-down level' does not contain its visible text '+ Add level' (WCAG 2.5.3). Fix: drop the aria-label, or make it 'Add level, drill-down' / visible text 'Add drill-down level'. Previously masked by the project-menu entry, which ui-data has since fixed

Intermittent (only while the pointer rests on it after the click): the shared primary Button (components/ui/button.tsx) fades to opacity 0.9 on hover, which takes white on the accent blue to 3.98:1 (needs 4.5:1). Same cause as the dashboard-add-menu entry. Fix: darken the hover colour instead of fading it
Radix modal dropdown aria-hides the skip link, header, aside and grid while they stay focusable

Dropdown filter trigger (FilterControl.tsx DropdownControl): aria-label '<label> filter' does not contain the visible value text ('All', 'North'); WCAG 2.5.3. Fix: include the value, e.g. aria-label='<label> filter: <value>'
same dropdown filter trigger, on the public share page
same dropdown filter trigger, on the public embed page
Dark theme only, same cause as dashboard-print: the print layout keeps the dark theme's light muted text on a white page

DashboardView's role=tablist, in edit mode, holds a text input (the active tab's name) and the Add tab / Remove tab buttons, none of which are allowed children of a tablist. Fix: keep the tablist to role=tab elements and move the editing controls outside it
'Add widget' trigger: white on the accent blue is 3.98:1 at hover:opacity-90 (needs 4.5:1). Fix: drop hover:opacity-90 or darken the hover state instead of fading it

Dark theme only: print.css forces a white page but text-muted keeps the dark theme's light grey (#9aa1ad on white, 2.6:1), so a dashboard printed from the dark theme has low-contrast captions, KPI titles and filter labels. Fix: also force the light token values for muted text under @media print
The generated HTML report (dashboard/report.ts buildReportHtml) has no <title>
The generated HTML report has no lang attribute on <html>
